newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTT in refinery talks with Aramco - papers.
newsitem.headline: PTT in refinery talks with Aramco - papers.

text.p: The Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) is discussing a refinery development deal in southern Thailand with Saudi Aramco, the Bangkok Post reported on Saturday.

Aramco is interested in a expanding its finished oil products business and is looking for a refinery location from which to supply target South Korean and Japanese markets, the papar attributed PTT Governor Pala Sookawesh as saying.

PTT is also in talks with Kuwait Oil Co, Japan's Itochu Corp and other unspecified Chinese and Korean firms to develop refineries in Thailand's southern seaboard development area 1,000 km south of Bangkok, the paper said.
